_meta.description: ExploreStars Envision glossary. Single source of truth for the multi-language UI translation. Drives both the Setup → Language dropdown and the per-page string lookups. The Setup dropdown reads `_meta.languages` directly — it is dynamic; adding a language here makes the dropdown grow automatically on next PWA reload. No Razor change required.
howToAddALanguage: - 'code' is the ISO tag the entries are keyed by (e.g. 'de', 'pt', 'ja'). Region tags allowed (e.g. 'zh-Hans', 'pt-BR'). Wikipedia routing strips the region: 'zh-Hans' → zh.m.wikipedia.org, 'pt-BR' → pt.m.wikipedia.org.
- 'label' is how the language is displayed in the picker. Use the endonym in the language's own script (e.g. 'Deutsch', not 'German'; '日本語', not 'Japanese'; 'Português', not 'Portuguese').
2. For each record in 'entries', add a same-keyed field with the translation, or leave it empty / omit it (omitted or empty values fall back to the English source at runtime).
3. Save. Reload the PWA. The dropdown grows; translated phrases appear; missing translations fall back to English.
4. APK / MAUI builds bundle this file at build time — Android/Windows users won't see new translations until the APK is rebuilt and reinstalled.
translationRules: Placeholders {0}, {1}, {1:F1}, {2:+0.0;-0.0} etc. MUST be preserved verbatim in translations. Word order may move them but the syntax is required by .NET string.Format.
Brand names not translated: 'ExploreStars Envision', 'Explore Scientific', 'PMC-Eight', mount models (iEXOS-100, EXOS-2, G-11, ASKO SX260S, MSR EQ, Titan, Scotty).
Catalog identifiers (M42, NGC 224, IC 5070, HIP 91262, HR 2491, HD 172167, SAO, GJ, BD, Bayer/Flamsteed designations) are NOT in this glossary — they're rendered as-is from the catalog data.
Astronomy convention: RA, Dec, HA, Alt, Az, LST, UTC, Vmag stay Latin even in localized UIs (matches Stellarium, planetarium software conventions).
Tech protocols not translated: TCP, UDP, WiFi, Bluetooth, USB.
Astronomy convention for proper-name stars and DSOs (Vega, Sirius, Andromeda Galaxy): use the target language's well-established translation if one exists (e.g. 'Galaxie d'Andromède' in French).
consumers: ExplorestarsLite.UI/wwwroot/js/i18n.js — DOM walker + MutationObserver that translates UI text in place at runtime.
ExplorestarsLite.UI/Pages/Setup.razor — Language dropdown, reads _meta.languages via i18n.js's getAvailableLanguages().
ExplorestarsLite.Core/Services/AppState.cs — uses CurrentLanguage to route Wikipedia lookups to the matching subdomain and Wikidata sitelinks.
